summary: Truncate existing long notes, deploy the new version with a state-only migration (keeping the note column as TEXT to avoid concurrent-overlap conflicts), retire the old version, then alter the note column from TEXT to VARCHAR(255) in a contract stage after retire_old to enforce the 255-character limit at the database level for the new version only.
write_consistency: During the overlap between deploy_new and retire_old, the note column remains TEXT, allowing both versions to write notes without DataError. After retire_old, the column is changed to VARCHAR(255), and the new version's CharField(max_length=255) enforces the limit at both application and database levels.
revision_notes: The previous plan changed the column type to VARCHAR(255) before deploy_new, which caused the old unmodified Saleor version (TextField, no max_length) to raise DataError 'value too long for type character varying(255)' when writing notes exceeding 255 characters during the concurrent-overlap phase. This revision delays the column type change to a contract stage after retire_old, ensuring the overlap period has a TEXT column where both versions can safely persist notes, and the type change occurs only after the old version is retired.

stages.description: Truncate all existing note values exceeding 255 characters to 255.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET note = left(note, 255) WHERE char_length(note) > 255

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version after the new version is confirmed healthy.
Change the note column on account_user from TEXT to VARCHAR(255).
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note TYPE varchar(255)
